meta.title: Cat Takes Over Dog's Bed — Pet Household Chaos

scenes.narration_en: A lazy cat spots a cozy dog bed in the corner.
The cat casually walks over and claims it as her own throne.
The dog returns and stares in disbelief at the intruder.
A tense standoff ensues — neither side willing to back down.
They somehow end up sharing the bed, utterly confused but content.
